question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A large cage, building or enclosure for keeping birds in
solution: The correct answer is '**Aviary**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Aviary**'. • It means 'a large cage or area in which birds are kept'. (पक्षीशाला, दरबा) • *Example: The birds will winter outside in an **aviary**.* **Correct Answer:__** *Aviary.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Apiary**: a place where bees are kept. (मधुवाटिका) • **Asylum**: protection that a government gives to people who have left their own country, usually because they were in danger for political reasons. [किसी राज्‍य या देश द्वारा अन्‍य देश के नागरिक को दी गई शरण (विशेषतः राजनैतिक कारणों से)] • **Aquarium**: a glass container filled with water, in which fish and water animals are kept. (पानी से भरी शीशे की टंकी जिसमें मछली आदि जलजीवों को रखा जाता है; मछलीघर, जलजीवशाला) 30:Tb4a, The correct answer is '**confirmed**'.
